body.summary: handoff.ts gains parkPlan(repo, unit, { runToken? }, deps?) and the types ParkPlan / ParkPlanResult / ParkDeps (deps lets tests replace the branch pattern lookup and the clock); runIsForUnit moved here from park-offer.ts (which now imports it). It only reads: it refuses, in this order, a Task unit (before the tracker is asked), a repo that does not enforce claims, a unit with no issue, nobody holding it ('claim it and continue'), the actor holding it (case-insensitive), a supplied token that is not a live run / belongs to another unit / has no owner / belongs to another user, no owned run and no uncommitted draft ('no draft or run to hand over'), and an invalid branch name (handoffBranchName: grammar, missing {id}, bad result); otherwise it chooses the actor's owned run for this unit (the supplied token, else listStates' newest touch) and assembles the checkpoint: a run checkpoint through buildRunCheckpoint (owner = actor, upstream = the entry's snapshot, parker paths made portable) or, with only a draft, a draft-only checkpoint, both with parkedBy, parkedAt, sourceHead (HEAD), repositoryId (the root commit id from rev-list --max-parents=0) and artifactPaths = the unit's uncommitted draft files. It returns the branch name, variant, runId, actor, holder, issue and port for the next task to carry out. config/github.ts gains resolveBranchPattern(repoPath) (the repo's own entry's branchPattern, else the default entry's, else undefined). The named test (real temporary git repo, real state store and gate with a fake tracker, bob as holder) covers every refusal above; an owned awaiting_llm_step run giving a run checkpoint with owner, the upstream snapshot, the root commit id, HEAD, no parker path anywhere, that passes validateCheckpoint after a JSON round trip; the default and a custom branch pattern; two owned runs choosing the newest touch, touching the older one flipping the choice, and a supplied token winning; a draft-only plan listing the untracked LLD json; a run plus a draft listing the draft in artifactPaths; and, after all of it, git status, branches and refs are unchanged and no run was stored by planning. Team and config suites pass; tsc clean.
